name: Divergence Grid Computation
aliases: Divergence Calculation with Obstacle Velocity Boundary Conditions
definition: Computes the divergence ∇·F = ∂Fx/∂x + ∂Fy/∂y + ∂Fz/∂z at every active voxel of a vector grid using central differences.
summary: Divergence Grid Computation calculates scalar divergence for 3D velocity grids using central finite differences and obstacle velocity boundary conditions to quantify fluid volume changes.
